answer: A tidal inlet guarding a walnut orchard is one gate: a flow valve caps claims at 200 per epoch, queuing fakes behind real workers. Each claim cracks one walnut, sequential proof-of-work on its hardware, 25 minutes per shell. Two long-lived agents graft each cracked walnut in, staking $10 apiece; one failed audit slashes both and freezes the graft 7 epochs. Forging 10,000 votes needs 4,166 cracking hours and $200,000 in stakes, throttled to a drip — like smuggling walnuts past the watch at low tide: every cracked hull costs a day's sweat, and one rotten walnut seizes the whole basket.
